claims.statement: Johnny Dwyer offered to send £10 to the editor of Bell's Life in London as a forfeit for a match with Tom Allen.

quotes.speaker: Johnny Dwyer
quotes.text: He has talked about me and maligned me in the inest scandalous manner, and I would just like to get mim before me in a twenty-tour foot ring.
quotes.topic: wants to fight Allen, who had maligned him

quotes.speaker: Jimmy Elliott
quotes.text: Il’m yiad that it wus Dwyer and not Tom Allen who licked me. 1 hope Jolunny will fight Alien
quotes.topic: glad Dwyer beat him, not Allen

notes: The Dwyer interview was printed from Buffalo, May 9, and says 'the other evening', so the date is approximate (the hint's 1879-05-08 is not in the text). The Dwyer-Elliott fight is not Allen's and is not recorded. Elliott's remark is included as a quote about Allen. The hint's 'promising to back Dwyer' is not in the text, so it is left out.
